name: Amathus Bilingual (EC1/ICS 196)
parsedInscription: ana matori umiesai mukulai lasana arisitonose aratowanakasokoose kerakeretulose takanasoti alo kailipoti
transcription: ana matori umiesai mukulai lasana arisitonose aratowanakasokoose kerakeretulose takanasoti alo kailipoti
notes: Real EC1/ICS 196 bilingual: a-na ma-to-ri... (11 words) + Greek HE POLIS HE AMATHOUSION. Source: cyprominoica.wordpress.com EC1 + Wikipedia Amathus_bilingual.

name: Amathus EC2/ICS 195
parsedInscription: mitarawano onasakoranoti onasakorani papono asatowanakasoko puruwano puruwanoti asataratonokoo kerakaretuloti oelotimotitusasokosoti onaitimo tasu puruwano
transcription: mitarawano onasakoranoti onasakorani papono asatowanakasoko puruwano puruwanoti asataratonokoo kerakaretuloti oelotimotitusasokosoti onaitimo tasu puruwano
notes: Real EC2/ICS 195 (Masson 1983): selected Eteocypriot words with Greek names bolded (Onasagoras etc.). Full text fragmentary with lacunae; words cleaned to hyphen-less. Source: cyprominoica EC2.

name: Amathus EC3
parsedInscription: tu alirani oite tusu taleya pakuke anoti tasoti apupi oite apima pina asona tukaiminona
transcription: tu alirani oite tusu taleya pakuke anoti tasoti apupi oite apima pina asona tukaiminona
notes: Real EC3: tu a-li-ra-ni o-i-te... 5 lines, fragmentary. Source: cyprominoica EC3.

name: Amathus EC4
parsedInscription: ana tasi susa ekiwijaki mana apoi eki mari mana sumira imikani puenemina panamo nio tarawi kawalija pina mi
transcription: ana tasi susa ekiwijaki mana apoi eki mari mana sumira imikani puenemina panamo nio tarawi kawalija pina mi
notes: Real EC4: a-na ta-si su-sa... 4 lines. Source: cyprominoica EC4.

name: Amathus EC5
parsedInscription: witileranu tana munoti ailo ekiyanoti mana ko tou pakimiranu tana mu noti
transcription: witileranu tana munoti ailo ekiyanoti mana ko tou pakimiranu tana mu noti
notes: Real EC5: wi-ti-le-ra-nu ta-na... 4 lines. Source: cyprominoica EC5.

name: Amathus EC14/ICS 198 (Purwos coin)
notes: Real EC14/ICS 198: pu-ru-wo-so on coin, possibly king Purwos. Source: cyprominoica EC14.
